script: Chapter 4. Software: Your SEO Toolset. Start with the free tools: Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Keyword Planner, and Google Trends. Add a paid suite only when a client needs it. Use a separate work account and a separate Chrome profile for each client. Never share a client's password. Ask for platform access instead. Practice: verify a test site in Search Console and run a Screaming Frog crawl. Recap: free tools first, paid tools when justified.
glossary: Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Keyword Planner, Google Trends
